review.note: A founding year from memory, and for the movements that were founded under another name it is also a question of which year the record should carry. The point on this record stands for a region or a seat it is not certain of. Check it, and drop it rather than keep a guess.

summary: Founded in Dar es Salaam in 1962 out of three earlier movements and led first by Eduardo Mondlane, it began the war in Mozambique in 1964 and took power at independence in 1975.
